truth.claim: 30,000 orbit moments plotted with no rule; a blind search over simple terms lands on the same shells; in 2021 a team's program found every exactly conserved quantity on 5 test systems and flagged the near ones
truth.note: the in-film search is our illustration (tagged); the 5-system result is Liu and Tegmark 2021 (PRL), read from snippets, grade A/B; 'the laws were known' is said on stage

truth.claim: 24,000 training dots (60 runs x 8 neurons x 50 moments); each neuron keeps one sum fixed, 8 in all; one neuron per layer slides along its layer and never leaves it; bigger steps and the layers leak
truth.note: the film's own recompute (grade B for the '8 sums' count, Kunin et al. 2021, Marcotte et al. 2023); the leak is the honest limit shown, not told

truth.claim: 3 independent questions in 6 orders total 20 every time (4 + 7 + 9); reordering cost more than 30 % in some tests (ICML 2024); the owner's tree: 19 questions in 3 layers (4, 8, 7), 9 modules, 22 sources
truth.note: the toy is tagged ILLUSTRATION; the tree scene carries PROGRAM, NOT A THEOREM from its first frame; counts are of what exists; the honest line says nobody has proved a Noether theorem for questions
